lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. A central group of four high-intensity blobs forms a distinct quadrangular arrangement in the mid-flank region, while posterior blobs align in semi-regular grid intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like pattern where spots are localized at the intersection nodes, most visible in the posterior section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse statistical distribution of approximately 8 to 12 low-resolution high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered within the lower-anterior quadrant of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple remoras (Echeneidae) visible in the water column immediately adjacent to the ventral-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin.
